protocol.surface: vulcanus (game.planets.vulcanus.create_surface; ground set to volcanic-ash-flats, natural entities removed, only the chunks under the blueprint kept)
protocol.research: exactly manifest.technologyClosure, nothing else: bulk inserter capacity bonus 1, inserter stack size bonus 0 (research:max sets them to the values of all seven capacity researches)
protocol.feed: belts: items put on the entrance belt (generous: one item a lane every tick the belt has room; throttled: a credit of perMinute/3600 a tick, capped at 8, one item a credit on alternating lanes); pipes: fluid put into one outside pipe touching the entrance (generous: kept full; throttled: perMinute/3600 a tick plus what was refused, capped at one second)
protocol.draw: a belt is placed beyond every exit, the way a player connects one, and emptied every four ticks; a blocked or unconnected exit is the same belt left alone
protocol.reach: a phase that waits for the rate ends when the trailing minute of the product exit reaches 95% of the target; its limit is a failure
protocol.acceptance: In every scenario: no pipe ever holds a fluid other than its network's (every fluid segment read every tick, every machine fluid box every five ticks), no machine box is joined to a pipe of another fluid, no unused port is joined to anything, no belt line carries an undeclared item and the exits give only their own item; the imported blueprint is exactly the string. Full length: from empty, 15 minutes of warm-up then 30 minutes measured at 95% of the target or more, once with every entrance offered more than it can take and once with every entrance offered exactly its panel figure; each input withheld from a cold start for 20 minutes and then supplied; the stone exit left unconnected for an hour and then connected. Goal-ended: with the product exit blocked for 15 minutes nothing crafts in the last five and the rate returns when it is released; the same with the stone exit; a five-minute outage of every input; five minutes without power; built a few entities at a time in three shuffled orders, pipes first, machines first and with either lava foundry group ten minutes late, supply and power live; lava and calcite cut for ten minutes each and each lava foundry group stopped for fifteen; placed turned in each direction and mirrored on each axis; and with every inserter capacity research done. After each of these the exit reaches the rate and then holds 95% of the target over ten measured minutes.

footprint.includes: all entities: machines, arms, belts, pipes, substations and panels; the outside supply and the belts and pipes a player connects are not counted
